resources.string:
The app has a built-in PRoot user-space Linux sandbox. When Echo calls the run_shell tool, it runs real Linux commands in the container (apt and pip installs, git, ffmpeg, python and more), without root.

Two distributions:
• Alpine: 3 MB, bundled in the APK, unpacked on first use
• Ubuntu: 28 MB, download it on this page before use

Security: isolated container root, bind mount allowlist (Download and Documents only), UID isolation, HIGH-risk gate, forced stop on timeout and a 64 KB output limit.
Not set up. Unpacks on the first run_shell call.
rootfs downloaded. Unpacks on the first run_shell call.
Ubuntu rootfs downloaded. run_shell can now use distro=ubuntu.

Echo uses this container whenever it calls the run_shell tool:
• run_shell command="ls -la /"
• run_shell command="apt install -y jq" distro=ubuntu
• run_shell_session (interactive session)

Alpine is the default (light and fast). Ubuntu suits work that needs glibc or the full apt ecosystem.
Bind mount allowlist: /sdcard/Download and /sdcard/Documents (read and write inside the container).
